summary.text: David Orentlicher is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 20 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A law professor and physician, he previously served in the Indiana House of Representatives from 2002 to 2008.

paragraphs.text: Orentlicher was born in Washington, D.C., and earned a B.A. in economics from Brandeis University and an M.D. and J.D. from Harvard University.
His career experience includes working as a law professor and director of the health law program at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
Orentlicher served in the Indiana House of Representatives from 2002 to 2008 and assumed office in the Nevada Assembly on November 4, 2020, succeeding Ellen Spiegel.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Education, Health and Human Services, and Judiciary committees.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, he listed improving public education, reducing health care costs and ensuring that all workers can earn a living wage as his top priorities.
